description: A hospital-developed blended retraining programme combining e-learning, virtual CPR simulation, and in situ team-based BLS/AED simulation for healthcare professionals, run within the APSS Trento hospital network.
title: riAniMO blended team-based CPR/AED retraining program

description: RiNeo MR is a mixed-reality newborn life-support training simulator developed by Coduri Mara et al.
title: RiNeo MR

description: A computerized real-time classroom-observation instrument developed at UC Davis to code and quantify instructor–student interaction patterns for research and teaching-assistant or faculty professional development.
title: RIOT (Real-time Instructor Observing Tool)

description: RiPPLE is an adaptive higher-education peer-learning platform for creating, evaluating, revising, and practising with peer-generated learning resources.
title: RiPPLE (Recommendation in Personalised Peer-Learning Environments)

description: The Ripple Tank Model is an open-source Easy Java Simulations computer simulation created by Loo Kang Wee and collaborators for A-level physics learners to explore two-source interference, coherence, displacement, intensity, and three-dimensional wave representations.
title: Ripple Tank Model
